feature_policy.objective: Measure the incremental value of a soil proxy and a vegetation/chlorophyll index on top of the locked RGB+NDVI+NDRE baseline.

soil_candidate.name: RE_BSI_PROXY
soil_candidate.label: RedEdge bare-soil proxy
soil_candidate.reason: DJI P4M has no SWIR band, so standard SWIR-based BSI cannot be computed. This red-edge proxy must not be reported as standard BSI.

vegetation_candidate.name: MCARI
vegetation_candidate.label: P4M-adapted MCARI
vegetation_candidate.reason: Adds RedEdge/Red/Green chlorophyll contrast and previously showed useful validation signal; its P4M band mapping still requires empirical validation.

feature_policy.promotion_rule: Seed-0 Mask mAP50-95 must improve by at least 0.003 over the locked five-channel seed-0 validation baseline before three-seed confirmation.
feature_policy.test_policy: Generate and use train/valid features only. Keep test sealed until a single final candidate is frozen.

notes: All layouts begin with R,G,B and retain NDVI,NDRE from the current five-channel model.
RE_BSI_PROXY is experimental and non-standard because no SWIR band is available.
MCARI is adapted to DJI P4M bands and is treated as a candidate, not a guaranteed improvement.
No slope, aspect, elevation, DEM, DSM, DTM or other terrain feature is included in this round.
